name: TFIs
description: Close-range armor doctrine: Tempest Fleet Issue battleships with Guardian and Zarmazd logistics, Revelation dreadnoughts, an Apostle FAX and carriers, Damnation and Eos command bursts, Bhaalgorn and Vindicator support and Devoter HICs. Fits are the doctrine's [FL33T] fits from my.minmatar.org doctrine 13. The page gives no counts; this example chooses 44 ships: an FC and two DPS squads of 10 Tempest Fleet Issues, 3 Bhaalgorns and 2 Vindicators at 2.5 km, 2 Devoters, a Damnation and an Eos, 5 Guardians and 3 Zarmazds on their own lead 30 km off the FC, 2 Revelations at 10 km, an Active Apostle 5 km off the logi lead, and a Thanatos, a Nidhoggur and an Archon at 15 km. The Buffer Apostle and the secondary (L3ARN) fits are left out. DNA and radius were checked against tools-core's SDE build 3632936 on 2026-10-21.
